description: DFT-D4 damping parameters per functional, extracted programmatically from the pinned dftd4 v4.3.1 source. Numbers are parsed from src/dftd4/param.f90::get_d4eeq_bjatm_parameter and cross-checked against assets/parameters.toml.

citation.title: A generally applicable atomic-charge dependent London dispersion correction
citation.authors: E. Caldeweyher, S. Ehlert, A. Hansen, H. Neugebauer, S. Spicher, C. Bannwarth, S. Grimme

model.two_body_energy_implemented: E_2 = -1/2 * sum_{i,j} C6_ij * sw_ij * ( s6 / (R_ij^6 + r0_ij^6) + s8 * rrij_ij / (R_ij^8 + r0_ij^8) )

variables.C6_ij: sum_{ref,ref'} w_ref(i)*w_ref'(j)*C6_ref,ref'(Z_i,Z_j); the reference weights w are CN- and charge-dependent (see reference_systems.json)
variables.sw_ij: quintic smooth cutoff switch, 1 for r <= cutoff-width (cutoff 60 bohr default)
variables.alp: NOT used by the two-body term; upstream uses it only in the ATM term

model.atm_three_body_energy_implemented: E_3 = sum_{i<j<k} ang_ijk * fdmp_ijk * C9_ijk with C9_ijk = -s9*sqrt(|C6_ij*C6_ik*C6_jk|), r0_ijk = prod r0_ab, fdmp = 1/(1 + 6*(r0_ijk/(r_ij r_ik r_jk))^(alp/3)), ang = 3/8*(...)/(r_ij r_ik r_jk)^5 + 1/(r_ij r_ik r_jk)^3
model.atm_note: get_rational_damping() prefers the 'bj-eeq-atm' table, whose dftd_param defaults s9 = 1.0, so the three-body term is on by default; s9 = 0 disables it (get_atm_dispersion returns immediately for |s9| < eps). disp.f90:139-141 resets q(:) = 0 before rebuilding C6 for the ATM call, so the three-body term uses weights evaluated at q = 0 while the two-body term keeps the charge-weighted C6.

charge_response.note: There are no s6q/s8q/a1q/a2q coefficients anywhere in dftd4 v4.3.1. The charge dependence of D4 enters (a) through the EEQ partial charges q used in the reference weighting, and (b) through the element-specific charge scaling zeta(ga, eta_i*gc, q_ref+zeff, q+zeff). The damping parameters s6, s8, a1, a2 are charge-independent constants.

charge_response_coefficients.note: upstream defines no charge-response damping coefficients; charge dependence is carried by the EEQ charges and the reference weighting zeta(ga, eta*gc, q_ref+zeff, q+zeff). See model.charge_response.

m06-2x.reason: dftd4 v4.3.1 has no damping parameter entry for this functional: the functional enumerator/param tables in src/dftd4/param.f90 do not contain it and assets/parameters.toml has no [parameter.*] block for it. No numbers are provided rather than inventing values.
